name: Dionne Hansen
story: LINZ’s 2016 geospatial virtual field trip identified Dionne Hansen as a Senior Geodetic/Geophysical Analyst. Her role sits in the specialist work that maintains and interprets New Zealand’s positioning framework, connecting geodetic observations with the coordinate infrastructure used by surveyors and GIS.
LINZ names Dionne Hansen in its geospatial virtual field-trip record: Senior Geodetic/Geophysical Analyst, LINZ, 2016 VFT.
